name: kind/bug
description: Something behaves differently from what the docs claim

name: kind/feature
description: New capability or a deliberate behaviour change

name: kind/chore
description: Build script, CI, or repository maintenance

name: area:build-publish
description: build_site.sh, index.yml, or the GitHub Pages deploy workflow

name: priority:P0
description: Plugin unusable for everyone; fix before anything else

name: priority:P1
description: Broken or misleading for a common setup; next release

name: priority:P2
description: Worth doing, no user is blocked

name: priority:P3
description: Backlog: nice to have, or waiting for a reason to touch the file

name: status/needs-info
description: Waiting on the reporter for logs, version, or scope

name: status/blocked-upstream
description: Needs a change in Stash itself before it can be fixed here

name: status/needs-verification
description: Written but not yet exercised in a live Stash instance

name: status/publish-pending
description: Merged but not published: the change still has to reach main under plugins/**
